Name: Harem Valley Extended Heart Album Integration
Author: SagiriYanami
Description:
Harem Valley Extended — Heart Album Integration
[b]Turn your cutscenes into collectible memories![/b]
This unofficial add-on brings Harem Valley Extended into the original Heart Album mod.
Collect beautiful custom photographs as you experience the events and cutscenes throughout Harem Valley Extended. Every supported scene can unlock its own photograph, allowing you to build a personal collection of memories from your adventures.
Instead of unlocking these pictures through friendship points, photographs are tied directly to their corresponding cutscenes.
[heading]✨ Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]80 Custom Photographs[/b] — A collection of specially created images for Harem Valley Extended.[/*]
[*][b]71 Event IDs Supported[/b] — Photographs are linked to their corresponding in-game events.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic Unlocking[/b] — Complete a supported cutscene to unlock its associated photograph.[/*]
[*][b]Original Heart Album Interface[/b] — Keeps the original album's interface and navigation.[/*]
[*][b]Friendship Hearts[/b] — Retains the original friendship-based progression for regular Heart Album photographs.[/*]
[*][b]Existing Save Support[/b] — Previously completed events can be recognized when loading a save.[/*]
[*][b]Alternative Photographs[/b] — Some scenes include additional image variations.[/*]
[*][b]HD Image Pack[/b] — All photographs are provided in 2560×1752 resolution.[/*]
[/list][heading]📸 How It Works[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install Heart Album and Harem Valley Extended.[/*]
[*]Install this integration add-on.[/*]
[*]Play Harem Valley Extended and complete its supported cutscenes.[/*]
[*]The corresponding photographs will automatically unlock.[/*]
[*]Open Heart Album to view your growing collection.[/*]
[/list]Each photograph is associated with a specific event ID, so you can collect memories as you progress through the mod.
[heading]📦 Installation[/heading]
[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.x[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/XXXXX]Heart Album[/url] by Ncyde[/*]
[*]Harem Valley Extended[/*]
[/list][b]Installation steps:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure Heart Album and Harem Valley Extended are installed and working.[/*]
[*]Download the main file.[/*]
[*]Extract
[code]HVEHeartAlbumSceneUnlocks[/code]into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Load your save and start collecting photographs![/*]
[/list]Optional HD Photographs
The main release already includes high-resolution photographs.
All images use 2560×1752 resolution. No additional installation is required.
[heading]⚠️ Important Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]This is an unofficial compatibility add-on for Heart Album and Harem Valley Extended.[/*]
[*]The original Heart Album mod is required and must be installed separately.[/*]
[*]Do not remove the original Heart Album.[/*]
[*]Photographs are unlocked through supported cutscenes, not friendship levels.[/*]
[*]Previously completed events are checked when loading an existing save.[/*]
[*]Avoid installing multiple language editions simultaneously.[/*]
[/list][heading]💖 Credits[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Heart Album[/b] — Original mod by Ncyde. All credit for the original album system and interface belongs to its author.[/*]
[*][b]Harem Valley Extended[/b] — Original mod and event framework by its respective author.[/*]
[*][b]HVE Heart Album Integration[/b] — Integration, event-to-photo mapping, localization and technical adjustments.[/*]
[*][b]Artwork[/b] — Custom AI-generated photographs created for this add-on.[/*]
[/list]
